name: Bounce
tier_1: Walls and wards bounce back 50% of what hits them, including characters.
movement: Squash-and-stretch rebounds off walls with a springy boing.
world: Walls wobble like jelly when touched.
raider_use: Ricochet past a guard you cannot out-fight.
defender_use: Line wards along walls so a bounce lands the crew in them.
weakness: Wardens are heavy enough to absorb a rebound.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Half gravity
tier_1: Everyone jumps twice as high and can leap one obstacle; thrown attacks fly 30% farther.
movement: Floaty strides and long, slow hops; cloaks and loot sacks drift upward.
world: Pebbles hover a hand above the ground; dust falls slowly.
raider_use: Leap the gaps the defender cannot wall off; reach roofs and ledges.
defender_use: Put loot where only a long leap reaches it, then watch that landing.
weakness: Heavy carriers barely rise; wind and slopes push a leaping crew off course.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Tilt
tier_1: The realm slopes toward a side the owner picks: +30% speed downhill, -30% uphill, and dropped loot rolls downhill.
movement: Arms windmill running downhill; bodies lean hard going uphill.
world: Trees, lanterns and banners lean one way; water runs downhill.
raider_use: Run downhill on the approach and drop loot so it rolls to the edge.
defender_use: Point the slope inward so every escape is uphill.
weakness: A Weight-note law woven beside it blunts the slide.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Current
tier_1: A wind blows one way, chosen by the owner: +30% speed with it, -30% against it.
movement: Bodies lean into the wind; hair and cloaks stream; steps lengthen downwind.
world: Grass waves and leaves stream in one direction.
raider_use: Ride it outward on the escape.
defender_use: Blow it toward the Heart so raiders fight it all the way in.
weakness: Cover breaks the wind; so does Stillness.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Heavy ground
tier_1: Flyers are grounded; carried loot weighs double, slowing carriers by 30%.
movement: Stomping steps with bent knees; carriers hunch under loot; flyers walk.
world: Grass lies flat; footprints sink deep.
raider_use: Slows the guards as much as the crew; Carriers are the ones who suffer.
defender_use: Pair it with a long route to the Vault.
weakness: Featherkin and Half gravity shrug it off.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Leapfrog
tier_1: Every third step is a hop that clears one tile. Landings are noisy: guards within 4 tiles notice 25% faster.
tiers_2_3: Hop every second step; noise only within 3 tiles
movement: A step-step-hop rhythm; each landing puffs dust.
world: Springy turf covered in hop marks.
raider_use: Hop fences and streams without a ramp.
defender_use: Gravel and bells under every hop landing.
weakness: The noise gives you away in a quiet realm.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Frictionless
tier_1: Anything moving keeps sliding until it hits something; top speed +20%.
movement: Skating glides with arms out for balance; spin-stops against walls.
world: Glossy ground with reflections.
raider_use: Slide a whole crew past a patrol in one push.
defender_use: Put pits and edges where a slide ends.
weakness: Nobody stops where they meant to, including you.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Inward pull
tier_1: Everything drifts toward the Heart: +25% speed going in, -25% going out, -35% for loaded carriers going out.
movement: A slight drift toward the Heart; feet drag when heading outward.
world: Faint spiral streaks lead toward the Heart.
raider_use: Dropped loot drifts toward the Heart, which is where you are going anyway.
defender_use: Makes the escape a climb out of a bowl.
weakness: Heavy crews barely feel it.
sound: a rising whistle and a soft thump on landing

name: Brittle stone
tier_1: Every structure takes double damage: pylons, vaults and wards, but also the owner's walls.
movement: Careful tiptoeing; wobbles on cracked tiles.
world: Hairline cracks everywhere; crumbs fall from walls.
raider_use: Break a wall instead of walking around it.
defender_use: Guards hear every break; wall the noisy routes.
weakness: The defender can break their own walls to open a charge.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Crystal growth
tier_1: Broken walls and hedges regrow as clear crystal after 8 seconds.
movement: Characters pause to tap humming crystal walls.
world: Crystals sprout where walls broke and hum softly.
raider_use: Growing crystal blocks a chase behind you.
defender_use: Regrow cover after every break, so routes never stay open.
weakness: It grows on both sides of a fight.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Glass
tier_1: Walls become see-through: nobody can hide behind them, though they still block movement.
tiers_2_3: Also reveals hidden wards; also shows guard vision cones
movement: Characters crouch behind glass walls, in vain.
world: Walls turn clear with coloured edges.
raider_use: See the patrol before you commit.
defender_use: They see you too: use it where you want them watched.
weakness: Shattered glass slows whoever is standing on it.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Density
tier_1: Big characters get +30% health and -20% speed; small ones get +25% speed and -20% health.
movement: Big characters lumber in slow motion; small ones scurry double-time.
world: Grass and props look slightly oversized.
raider_use: Send the small ones through and the big ones around.
defender_use: Design a route only small bodies fit.
weakness: Your Breakers become slow targets.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Honeycomb
tier_1: The ground is sticky: everyone moves 20% slower but can climb walls and cliffs one level.
tiers_2_3: Climb two levels; climbers can't be seen while on a wall
movement: Sticky steps pull golden strands; characters scale walls like geckos.
world: A golden hexagon sheen covers the ground.
raider_use: Climb any cliff the defender thought was a wall.
defender_use: Everything is slower, including the escape with a full sack.
weakness: Fire and Spark laws burn the stickiness away.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Lodestones
tier_1: The owner places two lodestones; carried loot is pulled toward them, slowing carriers moving away by 30%.
movement: Carriers are tugged sideways; sacks strain toward the stones.
world: Iron filings fan out around each lodestone.
raider_use: Pull a dropped sack back to you across a gap.
defender_use: Drag loot toward a guarded room.
weakness: Metal-heavy crews are pulled off their line.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Shifting stones
tier_1: Walls and boulders slide one tile every 15 seconds along a loop the owner draws.
movement: Characters wait at gaps, then dart through.
world: Walls glide along grooves with a grinding rumble.
raider_use: Wait for the gap and walk a wall that was not there.
defender_use: A maze that never repeats the same way twice.
weakness: Guards get stuck behind their own walls.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Transmute
tier_1: Carried loot swaps between Starlight and Essence every 20 seconds, losing 5% each time.
movement: Carriers juggle sacks that flicker between gold and green.
world: Loot glints and shifts colour.
raider_use: Turn awkward loot into something a Carrier can hold.
defender_use: Make the haul unpredictable so raiders cannot plan.
weakness: You cannot count your haul until you are out.
sound: a glassy chime and a low grind

name: Day and night
tier_1: The realm switches between light and dark every 30 seconds; vision halves in the dark.
movement: In the dark phase, characters hold lanterns high and tread carefully.
world: The sky flips between day and night.
raider_use: Time the run to the dark phase.
defender_use: Guards with lanterns own the dark; raiders must wait.
weakness: The cycle is public: both sides can plan around it.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Slow rivers
tier_1: Anyone in water moves at half speed. The owner can draw streams on the realm's grid.
movement: Slow-motion wading with big, lazy splashes.
world: Water flows like syrup; drops hang in the air.
raider_use: Water becomes cover you can stand in.
defender_use: A moat with no bridge.
weakness: Tidewalkers and Swimmers ignore it entirely.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Stillness
tier_1: Anyone standing still for 1.5 seconds becomes invisible to guards and wards.
movement: Frozen statue poses with a shimmering outline.
world: The air is calm; not a leaf moves.
raider_use: Stop moving and disappear.
defender_use: Guards that stand still cannot be tracked either.
weakness: Any Glow law breaks the hiding.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Afterimage
tier_1: Everyone leaves an afterimage that lingers for 3 seconds, and guards investigate afterimages.
movement: Translucent copies trail every character.
world: Faint ghost frames linger where people passed.
raider_use: Leave a copy where you are not.
defender_use: Guards chase ghosts, which buys time.
weakness: Your afterimages point at the route you took.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Delay
tier_1: Wards and abilities take effect 3 seconds after they are triggered.
movement: Characters flinch a beat late; effects land after a pause.
world: Ripples linger around anything triggered.
raider_use: Wards fire late, so you are already past.
defender_use: Alarms land after the crew has committed.
weakness: Your own guards react late too.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Haste
tier_1: Everyone moves 25% faster, and the heist clock runs 25% faster in this realm.
movement: Sped-up strides with motion lines and little skips.
world: Clouds race overhead; plants sway quickly.
raider_use: Cross open ground before anyone finishes looking.
defender_use: Guards reach the alarm faster than you reach the Vault.
weakness: Everything gets harder to control at speed.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Held breath
tier_1: Guards, wards and the crew's cooldowns only move while a crew member moves. The heist clock never stops.
tiers_2_3: The heist clock runs 20%, then 40% faster here
movement: When the crew stops, everything freezes mid-motion; the crew breathes in deeply.
world: Floating dust hangs still in the air.
raider_use: The world waits while you plan the next step.
defender_use: The clock does not wait: it burns while you stand still.
weakness: Stand-still crews are still visible.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Rewind
tier_1: Every 20 seconds, broken things return to how they were 10 seconds earlier.
movement: Characters glance back as debris flies back into place.
world: Broken pieces whoosh back where they were.
raider_use: Undo a broken plan once.
defender_use: Bring back the pylon they just broke.
weakness: It returns the defender's losses as readily as yours.
sound: a slow tick that stretches and snaps back

name: Glowing dark
tier_1: The realm is dark; beyond 3 tiles only glowing things can be seen.
movement: Glowing characters tiptoe; everyone else is a silhouette.
world: A black realm lit by glowing mushrooms and runes.
raider_use: The dark is cover.
defender_use: Put your glowing ruleborn on the routes that matter.
weakness: Anything that glows is a target.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Heat bloom
tier_1: Anyone within 2 tiles of a fire deals 25% more damage. The owner places braziers.
movement: Characters near fire puff up and swing faster, steam rising.
world: Heat haze around braziers.
raider_use: Fight near fire and hit harder.
defender_use: Bait the crew into fighting where your guards are strongest.
weakness: Your guards are stronger there too, but so are theirs.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Spark trails
tier_1: Anyone moving faster than a walk leaves sparks for 5 seconds that guards can see from anywhere in their sight.
movement: Runners leave crackling sparks; walkers tiptoe to stay dark.
world: Sparkles fade slowly on the ground.
raider_use: Walk, do not run, and leave nothing.
defender_use: Punish the crew for hurrying.
weakness: Your own patrols leave trails a raider can read.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Aurora
tier_1: Bands of light sweep the realm every 10 seconds. Inside a band everyone can be seen from twice as far; between bands, vision halves.
movement: Characters wait at the edge of a light band, then dash.
world: Ribbons of light sweep across the ground.
raider_use: Move between the bands and you are nearly invisible.
defender_use: Time patrols to the bands.
weakness: The pattern is readable, so it rewards patience on both sides.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Chain lightning
tier_1: Every hit jumps to a second target within 3 tiles at 50% strength.
movement: Hair stands on end; arcs jump between neighbours when hit.
world: Small arcs between metal props.
raider_use: One good hit clears a knot of guards.
defender_use: Keep guards apart and the chain dies.
weakness: It jumps between your crew as well.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Static
tier_1: Moving builds charge; after 5 tiles, the next touch stuns for half a second.
movement: Fur and hair frizz with every step; a zap pose on contact.
world: Crackling motes over the ground.
raider_use: Chain a stun through a clustered patrol.
defender_use: Cluster nothing; spread your guards.
weakness: Crews that bunch up get stunned together.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Overcharge
tier_1: Every third ability used in the realm, by anyone, fires twice.
movement: Every third ability animation doubles with an afterflash.
world: Pylons pulse in threes.
raider_use: Every third ability is a hammer.
defender_use: Wards hit three times as hard on the beat.
weakness: The beat is visible: count it.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Sunburst
tier_1: Every 25 seconds a flash stuns anyone not in shade for 1.5 seconds.
movement: Characters duck into shade at the warning glint.
world: A sun flare every 25 seconds; shade patches are marked.
raider_use: Shade is a safe lane if you read it.
defender_use: Remove the shade and the route becomes a gauntlet.
weakness: Your guards burn in the open too.
sound: a crackle building to a short clap

name: Bloom
tier_1: Cut hedges regrow after 10 seconds.
movement: Characters push through hedges that close behind them.
world: Hedges sprout back in time-lapse.
raider_use: Cut through and the hedge closes behind you.
defender_use: Regrown hedges reroute a chase.
weakness: It hides the crew as readily as it blocks them.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Kinship
tier_1: Characters standing next to an ally heal each other 1.5% a second.
movement: Allies walk shoulder to shoulder, linked by a green thread.
world: Vines braid between neighbours.
raider_use: Keep the crew together and they hold longer.
defender_use: Guards near each other heal each other.
weakness: Splitting the crew loses the bonus.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Wild paths
tier_1: Tiles walked three times grow flowers that make anyone on them 20% faster, so guards' patrols become fast lanes.
movement: Characters skip along flower paths.
world: Flowers bloom wherever people walk.
raider_use: Use the guards' own worn paths to move fast.
defender_use: Your patrol routes become raider highways.
weakness: The paths reveal where your guards walk.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Flock
tier_1: A flock of six puffballs wanders the realm and blocks narrow paths. Bumping one makes it bleat: guards within 5 tiles become 30% more aware.
movement: Characters weave and shush their way through bleating puffballs.
world: Fluffy puffballs graze across the realm.
raider_use: Hide in the flock and move with it.
defender_use: A living alarm nobody can predict.
weakness: Puffballs block your guards' paths too.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Spores
tier_1: Drifting pollen clouds make anyone inside for 2 seconds drowsy: -50% speed for 3 seconds.
movement: Drowsy yawns, slow blinks and stumbles.
world: Pollen clouds drift lazily.
raider_use: Cross the sleeping guards, not the awake ones.
defender_use: A pollen field in front of the Vault.
weakness: Wind carries it back over your own posts.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Thorns
tier_1: Touching walls or hedges costs 5% health.
movement: Characters flinch away from walls and hop around hedges.
world: Thorny vines cover walls and hedges.
raider_use: Avoid the walls; the middle is safer.
defender_use: Make every shortcut cost health.
weakness: Your own guards cannot hug the hedges either.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Regrowth
tier_1: Buildings, wards and guards heal 2% of their health each second.
movement: Guards' wounds glow green and close as they walk.
world: Moss creeps over everything.
raider_use: Take the fights you can finish quickly.
defender_use: Guards come back from almost anything.
weakness: Healing does nothing against a knockout.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Swarm birth
tier_1: Each knocked-out guard splits into two small guards with 30% of its strength.
movement: Knocked-out guards pop into two tiny guards that toddle after the crew.
world: Seed pods cluster around guard posts.
raider_use: Ignore the small ones and keep moving.
defender_use: Every knockout becomes two more bodies.
weakness: The swarm gets in your guards' way.
sound: a kalimba phrase and rustling leaves

name: Haunting
tier_1: Carried loot leaves a glowing trail; guards following it move 50% faster.
movement: Carriers glance nervously at the glowing trail behind them.
world: Ghostly footprints trail anyone carrying loot.
raider_use: Drop the loot and the trail dies.
defender_use: Make carrying loot the dangerous part.
weakness: The trail also shows a defender where a raid went.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Soul lanterns
tier_1: Lantern light marks safe ground; outside it, everyone loses 1% health a second.
movement: Characters hurry between pools of lantern light and flicker when outside them.
world: Warm lantern pools in cold blue dusk.
raider_use: Lantern light is safe ground.
defender_use: Light exactly the routes you can watch.
weakness: Light where you stand is light where you are seen.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Whispers
tier_1: When one guard raises the alarm, every guard in the universe hears it.
tiers_2_3: Guards also move 10%, 20% faster when alerted
movement: Guards cup their ears; an alarm travels as a visible wave.
world: Whispering wind lines drift between guards.
raider_use: Keep it clean; one alarm tells everyone.
defender_use: The whole universe answers a single shout.
weakness: Your guards' confusion also travels.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Echoes
tier_1: Knocked-out characters and guards return once, at 60% strength.
movement: Knocked-out characters rise as translucent echoes that float a little.
world: Soft chimes; faint silhouettes.
raider_use: A knocked-out crew member comes back once.
defender_use: So do knocked-out guards.
weakness: Echoes are visible: they mark where you fell.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Sleepwalk
tier_1: Guards patrol with their eyes closed: they can't see, but hear anyone moving faster than a walk within 4 tiles.
movement: Guards shuffle with arms outstretched and eyes closed; the crew tiptoes theatrically.
world: Dreamy haze with drifting Z-shaped motes.
raider_use: Walk, never run, and they never see you.
defender_use: Silent patrols that cannot be baited by sight.
weakness: Sleeping guards cannot raise an alarm quickly.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Soul swap
tier_1: A character about to be knocked out swaps places with its nearest ally, who takes half the blow.
movement: A magenta swirl as two characters trade places.
world: Wisps orbit every character.
raider_use: Trade places to pull someone out of trouble.
defender_use: Guards trade places across a chokepoint.
weakness: The swirl shows exactly where both ends are.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Borrowed Face
tier_1: For the first 10 seconds in the realm, guards can't tell crew from guards unless the crew runs or uses an ability.
movement: Everyone wears a mask; the crew copies the guards' marching step.
world: Festival lanterns and confetti.
raider_use: Walk in with the patrol for ten seconds.
defender_use: Raiders cannot tell your guards apart either.
weakness: Running breaks the disguise instantly.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell

name: Mirror images
tier_1: One guard in three is an illusion; illusions vanish when touched but still raise the alarm if they see a crew.
movement: Guards shimmer; illusions pop into sparkles when touched.
world: Mirror glints in the corners of the eye.
raider_use: Half the guards are not there.
defender_use: A patrol that looks twice its size.
weakness: Illusions pop on contact: one hit tells the truth.
sound: a distant choir swell and a single bell
